verdict.rationale: The SOS's own business page lists a "Mass change registered agent (PDF)" form, a documented first-party bulk operation that updates the registered agent across many entities at once. It also offers business-data requests through the Intelligence Center. These are narrow and appear to be PDF/manual processes rather than programmatic bulk actions. The keyless JSON API runs on the separate Socrata open-data platform, not the registry, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: programmatic or API-driven bulk filing, bulk operations beyond registered-agent changes (e.g., batch periodic reports or renewals), documentation of how the mass-change process works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
